prohibited: answer keys, builder reports, source code, reveal files, prior judgements and policy thresholds
procedure: Copy only the listed inputs into a fresh quarantine directory.
Record a recursive SHA-256 inventory before opening an input.
Run the role command and write only the specified output schema under the quarantine directory.
Seal the output and tell-audit it before mounting the reveal directory.
A different verifier joins sealed output to reveal material; the role never revises an answer after reveal.

roles.allowed: The neutral recall prompt, the 500-word baton and session identifier only.
roles.thresholds: Not disclosed to this role; verifier applies RI-EXP02.
roles.output_schema: elder-souls/recall-run@1; verbatim recalled claims, confidence and source session id

roles.allowed: Sealed recall and complete trace; no builder interpretation or blind-pair reveal.
roles.thresholds: RI-EXP02: verified anecdotes/hour >=4.0, unpredicted_count >=3, blank_hours=0, plus all T1-T5, generic, arose, hops and confabulation bounds.
roles.output_schema: elder-souls/anecdote-verification@1; every claim linked to exact trace offsets or rejected with reason

inputs: the actual redacted text/trace excerpts named by PACK.md
roles.allowed: Randomised A/B labels and actual excerpts only; no features-only surrogate.
roles.thresholds: Not disclosed until judgement is sealed; apply the native RI-EXP02 blind threshold after reveal.
roles.output_schema: elder-souls/blind-anecdote-judgement@1; per-pair preference, rationale, confidence and no-tie reason

roles.allowed: Timestamped trace and neutral SS proposal brief only; no run labels, expected arm, thresholds or builder scoring.
roles.thresholds: Not disclosed to annotator; scorer applies SS1-SS6 and matched comparison after sealing.
roles.output_schema: JSONL: session_id, beat_id, start_frame, end_frame, cited_event_offsets, confidence

inputs: final committed W1-25 artifacts and the authoritative governing items
roles.allowed: Entire final commit only after all other quarantined outputs are sealed.
roles.thresholds: All RI-CMP01, RI-EXP02, RI-EXP03 and RI-EXP06 native predicates; critic must falsify before verdict.
roles.output_schema: Repository verdict schema; PASS or exactly one actionable biggest gap. Builder makes no PASS claim.
